findings.description: The separator condition is inverted, changing the existing help output for options with secondary spellings.
findings.rationale: For a boolean option declared as `--foo/--no-foo`, `any_prefix_is_slash` is false, so this now renders `--foo; --no-foo` instead of `--foo / --no-foo`. Slash-prefixed option pairs receive the opposite incorrect separator. Since `get_help_record` delegates to this method, existing command help output changes.
